source_freeze.source_freeze_note: Post-amendment prefix freeze for the unchanged v004 generator and shared evaluator after the earlier prefix exposed outcomes. The amendment adds bounded per-run RSS/deadline enforcement and uses a new packaged executable; this prefix is an additive diagnostic equivalence check, not calibration, promotion, or a claim that the earlier outcomes were unopened.

falsifier.null: paired event-minus-control expectancy <= 0 or event expectancy <= 0 after costs
falsifier.estimand: cluster-level net P&L divided by aggregate fixed-stop risk; bootstrap unit is one merged lifecycle cluster
falsifier.failure_disposition: ECONOMIC_FAILURE only after valid full-scope minimums; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
